description: Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies, version 2. For studies evaluating diagnostic test accuracy.

questions.question: Was a consecutive or random sample of patients enrolled?
Did the study avoid inappropriate exclusions?
questions.guidance: Difficult-to-diagnose patients should not be excluded.

questions.question: Were the index test results interpreted without knowledge of the reference standard?
Was a pre-specified threshold used?
questions.guidance: Threshold should be defined a priori, not optimized post-hoc.

questions.question: Is the reference standard likely to correctly classify the target condition?
Were the reference standard results interpreted without knowledge of the index test?
Was there an appropriate interval between index test and reference standard?
questions.guidance: Short interval to avoid condition changes.

questions.question: Did all patients receive the same reference standard?
Were all patients included in the analysis?
